csv_scope_of_work: Progressive Design Build Services for the I-680 Northbound Express Lane Completion. title: Progressive Design-Build Services for the I-680 Northbound Express Lane Completion
short_description: Design-build procurement for express lane conversion, widening, and braided ramps on I-680 northbound.
project_scope: Completion of the I-680 northbound express lane corridor. The project may include conversion of the existing HOV lane to an express lane for HOV and toll-paying vehicles, addition of one express lane through widening of northbound I-680, and braided ramps separating the Treat Boulevard off-ramp from the North Main Street/Lawrence Way on-ramp to improve merging efficiency and safety.
services: Progressive design-build services; requested disciplines include design-build/developer, civil engineering, public transit planning, traffic design engineering, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Highway corridor project focused on express lanes and ramps, not a bridge or special structure.
- No explicit bridge, long-span, roof, stadium, or architecturally demanding structural component is described.
- Procurement is for progressive design-build, which includes planning input, but the listed disciplines are mainly roadway, traffic, and transportation planning.
- Limited fit with sbp's core strengths in bridges, lightweight structures, and special structures.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated. Only total construction cost of 312,000,000 USD is provided; procurement is a progressive design-build package for highway widening, express lane conversion, and braided ramps.
references_qualifications: Requested disciplines: design-build/developer, civil engineering, public transit planning, traffic design engineering, and transportation planning. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the notice.
